req.title: Player payload includes firstName and lastName
req.statement: The system shall include firstName and lastName fields on every player response.
triggers: player payload includes firstname and lastname

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-033 requires that every player response from GET /players/{id} includes firstName and lastName fields. The PlayerResponseModel uses camelCase aliasing (to_camel), so the JSON keys are 'firstName' and 'lastName'. Tests must: (1) confirm a known player returns HTTP 200 with exact firstName and lastName values (positive/EP), (2) confirm a non-existent UUID returns HTTP 404 and no player body (negative/NEG), (3) confirm the boundary player (squad number 1, first row) returns correct firstName/lastName (BVA), (4) confirm the last seeded player (squad 26) also returns correct fields (BVA upper boundary), and (5) confirm an invalid UUID format returns HTTP 422 (NEG/DT). All UUIDs are taken from the pre-loaded fixture. camelCase field names are asserted exactly to catch any alias-mutation.

tests.name: test_player_response_includes_firstName_and_lastName_positive
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 26 fixture rows
Player with id=acc433bf-d505-51fe-831e-45eb44c4d43c (Lionel Messi, squad 10) exists
trace: R-PLAYER-033: every player response must include firstName and lastName
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_player_response_includes_firstName_and_lastName_positive():
    r = client.get('/players/acc433bf-d505-51fe-831e-45eb44c4d43c')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert 'firstName' in body
    assert 'lastName' in body
    assert body['firstName'] == 'Lionel'
    assert body['lastName'] == 'Messi'
    assert isinstance(body['firstName'], str)
    assert isinstance(body['lastName'], str)
    assert len(body['firstName']) > 0
    assert len(body['lastName']) > 0

tests.name: test_player_response_camelCase_keys_exact_for_messi
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 26 fixture rows
Player Lionel Messi (squad 10) exists with id=acc433bf-d505-51fe-831e-45eb44c4d43c
actions: Inspect all top-level keys in the JSON response
expected: Snake_case variants 'first_name' and 'last_name' are NOT present as top-level keys
trace: R-PLAYER-033: fields must be named firstName and lastName (camelCase per alias_generator=to_camel)
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_player_response_camelCase_keys_exact_for_messi():
    r = client.get('/players/acc433bf-d505-51fe-831e-45eb44c4d43c')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body.get('firstName') == 'Lionel'
    assert body.get('lastName') == 'Messi'
    assert 'first_name' not in body
    assert 'last_name' not in body
    assert body['firstName'] != ''
    assert body['lastName'] != ''
